summary: Bilibili filed a 6-K reporting completion of a US$500 million convertible senior notes offering due 2031, a concurrent HK$115.38 fixed-price placement of 33,351,660 Class Z shares, and a concurrent delta repurchase of approximately US$100 million of shares. Notes convert at 50.3374 shares per US$1,000, an initial price of about HK$155.79, a 28.3% premium to the September 4 HK$121.40 close and 35.0% to the Reference Price. Tencent's US$200 million notes subscription and US$200 million share repurchase from Tencent require independent shareholder approval at an EGM. Watch shareholder-approval risk and hedge-driven share overhang.
